name: Jászkisér (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Jászkisér: a crowned blue shield with an arm holding a sabre within a yellow baroque frame.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jászkisér arms with crown and frame
